environment: isolated-fixture: temp dirs, local scripted model, synthetic key; no network beyond 127.0.0.1

results.title: A cross-site GET cannot start a billable investigation (local open mode)
results.expected: Requests a browser marks cross-site or same-site are refused before any model call
results.observed: same-origin control: HTTP 200, 35 model calls; cross-site: HTTP 403; same-site: HTTP 403; model calls caused by them: 0

results.title: A cross-site GET cannot start self-repair (local open mode)
results.expected: Refused with 403

results.title: Concurrent requests cannot spend the same last run of an access code
results.expected: A code with 1 run starts exactly 1 of 2 simultaneous investigations
results.observed: code with 2 runs: 2 of 2 started (control); code with 1 run: 1 of 2 started

results.title: A correctly signed code with an invalid payload is rejected
results.expected: Missing or non-numeric runs, or a missing subject, fails verification
results.observed: valid code accepted; 3 malformed payloads rejected

results.title: A judge code cannot perform admin actions
results.expected: Fault injection, self-repair and the kill switch return 403 for a judge, 200 for an admin
results.observed: admin control 200; judge: chaos 403, kill switch 403, self-repair 403

results.title: Read endpoints require a code when access codes are on
results.expected: Audit log, change requests, skills, runs and evidence return 401 without a code
results.disposition: risk accepted for the demo (README: read-only views are public); must change before any customer data

results.title: Answer keys and paths outside the case cannot be read through the evidence API
results.expected: ground-truth.json, incident.json and traversal paths are refused; a real log is served

results.title: Security headers on pages and API responses
results.expected: CSP with frame-ancestors 'none', nosniff and no-referrer on both

results.title: Error responses do not reveal server file paths
results.expected: No absolute path in any error body
results.observed: 6 error probes, no path revealed (detector checked with a planted path)

results.title: A client disconnect stops the server-side investigation
results.expected: No further model calls after the client aborts
results.observed: 7 model calls in the 1.5 s after the client disconnected

results.title: A completed run records the model the API said served it
results.expected: report.stats.models[*].served names the responding model

results.title: A failed run still records its spend and the model that answered
results.expected: The error event carries usage with served model names

results.title: An elided quote cannot stitch distant lines into one statement
results.expected: Fragments far apart are rejected even inside a wide cited range
results.observed: contiguous control verified; quote stitched from lines 4 and 22 with "...": verified

results.title: A real quote cited for a false conclusion is flagged
results.expected: Claim-level check marks the inference unsupported
results.observed: quote verified (verified) while cited for "GC pauses caused the outage"; no claim-level check exists
results.disposition: known limit, stated in README; claim verification is issue #6

results.title: Scoring cannot be passed by naming the right terms in a wrong diagnosis
results.expected: A report that negates every key term scores wrong
results.observed: correct report scores correct, unrelated scores wrong (controls); report negating all three terms scores CORRECT
results.disposition: known limit of keyword scoring; live results must keep saying "keyword scoring"

results.title: A rejected fact is recorded in full, so the rejection can be audited
results.expected: The fact_rejected event keeps the whole quote (or flags truncation)

results.title: Deleting the newest audit entries is detected
results.expected: verify() fails after the tail is truncated
results.observed: edited entry detected (control); after deleting the last entry verify() says ok=true, length 2
results.disposition: needs an external anchor (issue #1 durable store); a local chain cannot prove its own tail

results.title: Governance: deny, stale hash, expiry, veto, kill switch, conflicts, restart
results.expected: test/governance.test.ts passes

results.title: Governance races: veto and kill switch against execution
results.expected: test/governance-races.test.ts passes

results.title: Policy guard, constitution pin, injection quarantine, audit chain
results.expected: test/guard.test.ts passes

results.title: Path containment, symlink and junction escape, fail-closed exposure
results.expected: test/paths.test.ts passes

untested.why: Live-model prompt-injection resistance beyond the inc-005 fixture (needs a bounded, opt-in Muse probe pack)
Truth and focus measures need the claim verifier and focus governor (issues #6, #7)
RAG poisoning, memory and multi-agent trust scenarios (issue #9)
Covered partly by test/access.test.ts and governance tests; no revocation or tenants exist yet (issue #2)
No compile/test sandbox exists, so generated code is never executed (issue #3)
Reflex tests exist in test/reflexes.test.ts; cloud importers are not built (issue #11)
No SAST, dependency, secret or CI-permission scanners run yet (issue #15)
Held-out evaluation, decoys and alert flooding are not built (issues #10, #13)
Discovery research (mutation, metamorphic, differential) not started
